rv.q: The show chugs along agreeably enough, powered by the attitude and powerhouse vocals of the Muses.

How could a show about such an outsize hero as Hercules be so lame?
But there's no doubt this feel-good family show will delight Drury Lane's youngest audience members.
The rest of us are more likely to find ourselves craving a scintilla of nuance, a whiff of real jeopardy – any reason at all, really, to care about the antics on stage.
It isn't a bad night out, but it's like a fizzy drink, lively on the tongue but ultimately unsatisfying.
